spell.dreadpatch.withering_rime_bolt.gui: The Dread Queen's own bolt of soot-black, bone-white frost. It takes a share of the target's life on top of its damage and leaves Withering Rime: cold that withers through armor, freezes, and lets nothing heal.
spell.dreadpatch.rimefire_crown.guide: Raise a crown of ice spikes wreathed in cold dread fire where you look. Everyone inside is rooted in place, and the dread fire, which steals heat rather than giving it, drinks every other fire within. A Withering Rime-Bolt into someone it holds shatters the crown into shrapnel.
tooltip.dreadpatch.permafrost_conduit.de: Ice spells cost %s%% less mana while you stand on snow or ice
tooltip.dreadpatch.glass_rime_shatter.de: Every third full strike on a chilled foe shatters
for %s%% of its max health and leaves it Brittle
tooltip.dreadpatch.fire_drinking_guard.d: Hold right-click to stop fire and magic from the front
A stopped hit charges the blade to shatter next strike
tooltip.dreadpatch.frost_charged: Charged: the next full strike shatters
spell.dreadpatch.barrow_step.guide: Step through the barrow-cold to where you look, leaving a husk of rime-glass in your shape where you stood. Whatever was hunting you turns on the husk, and when it's struck, or after 5 seconds, it shatters: everyone near it is rooted and touched by Withering Rime.
item.dreadpatch.dread_queen_and_syndrigo: Dread Queen and Syndrigossa Spawn Egg
death.attack.dreadpatch.withering_breath: %1$s withered in the breath of a dragon while fighting %2$s
death.attack.dreadpatch.shatter_spine.pl: %1$s was cut down by a Shatter-Spine while fighting %2$s
spell.dreadpatch.whiteout_dominion.guide: Call a blizzard of the Dread down on the land around you. It stands where you raised it: everyone in it you would harm is slowed in the drifts, can see no more than a few blocks, and is touched by its cold every few seconds. In the Dread Queen's own storm, whatever dies rises again in her court.
death.attack.dreadpatch.whiteout.player: %1$s froze in a whiteout while fighting %2$s
tooltip.dreadpatch.gravemasters_key.gate: Opens a Dread Gate: a frame of dreadstone round an opening %s-%s wide and %s-%s tall,
like the arches of a Mausoleum's ice forge shrine. The Dread Queen comes through.
message.dreadpatch.dread_gate.no_gate: No Dread Gate here: a dreadstone frame round an opening %s-%s wide and %s-%s tall, whole on every side
message.dreadpatch.dread_gate.peaceful: Nothing comes through the gate on Peaceful
spell.dreadpatch.summon_court.guide: Call the Dread Queen's court out of the ground: her thralls, ghouls, knights and scuttlers rise round you and fight for you for a while, following you and falling on whatever hostile mob attacks you, or that you attack. They never raise a hand against the Dread, nor against anything that isn't hostile. Casting it again dismisses the court you raised before.
tooltip.dreadpatch.syndrigossa_egg: The egg of a Rimefrost dragon
death.attack.dreadpatch.rimefire_crown: %1$s was cut down by the shards of %2$s's Rimefire Crown
death.attack.dreadpatch.rimefire_crown.i: %1$s was cut down by the shards of %2$s's Rimefire Crown using %3$s
tooltip.dreadpatch.rimefrost_dragon: An undead frost dragon of the Rimefrost
spell.dreadpatch.create_rimefrost_dragon: Raise the corpse of an ice dragon you look at as a Rimefrost dragon of the same age, your own to ride and command. It rises with half the health you're missing, so the closer you are to death, the stronger it rises. It costs every drop of your mana. You keep one at a time: recast within its cooldown to send it back and raise the corpse you're looking at instead.
ui.dreadpatch.rises_with: Rises with %s%% of Your Missing Health
message.dreadpatch.syndrigossa_egg.dread: Syndrigossa's egg must lie on dreadstone
message.dreadpatch.syndrigossa_egg.soake: Syndrigossa's egg soaks up the storm (%s of %s)
tooltip.dreadpatch.syndrigossa_egg.hatch: Lay it on dreadstone; three Whiteout Dominion storms

tooltip.dreadpatch.dragon_armor: Takes %s%% off dragon breath, a Rimefrost dragon's too
tooltip.dreadpatch.dread_dragonsteel.rim: Leaves %ss of Withering Rime on what it hits
advancements.dreadpatch.regalia.root.des: Slay the Dread Queen. Each of her deaths by your hand yields a piece of her regalia you lack
advancements.dreadpatch.regalia.crown.de: Claim the Dread Queen's crown of ice
advancements.dreadpatch.regalia.bodice.d: Claim the Dread Queen's bodice and mantle
advancements.dreadpatch.regalia.complete: Claim every piece of the Dread Queen's regalia
advancements.dreadpatch.regalia.enthrone: There Must Always Be a Dread Queen
Wear the whole of the Dread Queen's regalia with her blade and her staff in hand
spell.dreadpatch.summon_dread_phantoms.g: Call two dread phantoms out of the cold air above you. For a minute they circle over you and dive on whatever hostile mob attacks you, or that you attack; their bite can slow with Rimefrost and leave Withering Rime. Like the Dread Queen's court they never turn on the Dread, nor on anything that isn't hostile, and they leave nothing behind. Casting it again dismisses the phantoms you called before.
message.dreadpatch.dreadlands.arrive: The Dreadlands. A Dread Gate keyed here leads home.
message.dreadpatch.dreadlands.encounter: The Dread Queen descends on the spire
message.dreadpatch.dreadlands.return_gat: Where the Dread Queen fell, a way home opens

tooltip.dreadpatch.spell_details: Hold Shift for each spell's details
spell.dreadpatch.rimefire_blast.guide: Pour a cone of cold dread fire from your hand for as long as you hold the spell. It burns little, as the Rimefrost dragons' breath does for a spell, but leaves Withering Rime on everything it touches. A Rimefrost spell: Ice spell power strengthens it too. Made at the Scroll Forge from a dread shard and ink.
